en.headline: Victoria Park Mid-Autumn lantern carnival runs through early October
en.dek: The free carnival at Victoria Park lights up nightly from 6.30pm to 11pm, extended to midnight over the festival weekend, with displays continuing until 4 October.
body: The Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival at Victoria Park continues to draw visitors during the festival period, with large-scale lantern displays, performances and free admission.
Organised by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department, the carnival runs from 17 September to 4 October. Lighting hours are 6.30pm to 11pm, extended to midnight from 24 to 27 September.

Additional lighting installations are on show at other sites including the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza. The event forms part of the city’s traditional Mid-Autumn celebrations on the festival day of 25 September.

zh.headline: 維園中秋綵燈會亮燈至10月初
zh.dek: 維多利亞公園中秋綵燈會每晚6時30分至11時亮燈，節日周末延至午夜，展覽持續至10月4日，免費入場。
body: 維多利亞公園中秋綵燈會在節日期間繼續吸引市民參觀，設有大型綵燈展覽及表演，免費入場。
由康樂及文化事務署舉辦的綵燈會由9月17日至10月4日舉行。亮燈時間為晚上6時30分至11時，9月24至27日延至午夜。
香港文化中心廣場等地亦有綵燈裝置。活動是本市中秋傳統慶祝的一部分，節日為9月25日。
